reader.requirement: At 85 a LINE NUMBER clause with NEXT PAGE may appear only in a body group (CONTROL HEADING, DETAIL, CONTROL FOOTING) or a REPORT FOOTING group; in a REPORT HEADING, PAGE HEADING or PAGE FOOTING group (on the 01 or a subordinate entry, abbreviated or spelled out) it must be refused.

edition-consulted.switches: a LINE operand of NEXT PAGE with no integer (the 2002 third alternative) refused below 2002 (COBOL0900, report-line-next-page-2002)
a multiple LINE clause and the LINES/NUMBERS/ARE spellings refused below 2002 (COBOL0900, report-multi-line-2002)

reader.edition-search: The SR7 test (kind not in ControlHeading/Detail/ControlFooting/ReportFooting) consults no edition; WrittenGroupKind/GroupKindOf map the written TYPE with no edition switch.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the same group-kind screen at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f30_05 covers NEXT PAGE in a permitted group; not exercised: the refusal in RH, PH and PF, a subordinate entry's NEXT PAGE, and CH/CF runtime placement.

reader.notes: ScreenReportLineClauses carries the group kind from the level-01 TYPE clause down to every subordinate LINE clause and refuses NEXT PAGE outside CH/DE/CF/RF. The diagnostic cites §2023:13.18.35.3 SR8, the same rule. The two positive probes also confirm the 1985 body group fit test 3c page advance for NP groups.
